tools.name: get_point_conditions
tools.description: Get lunar surface conditions at one point and time: the Sun's and Earth's azimuth/elevation (relative to a smooth-sphere horizon, no terrain occlusion), Earth's distance and phase. Terrain and year statistics are not available yet and are returned as null with a provenance note.

latDeg.description: Selenographic latitude in degrees, north positive, -90 to 90

lonDeg.description: Selenographic longitude in degrees, east positive, -180 to 360

time.description: UTC time in ISO 8601 with a trailing Z, e.g. 2026-11-14T12:00:00Z. Defaults to now. Valid 2000-2100.

tools.name: compare_points
tools.description: Compare lunar surface conditions at several points (up to 10) at the same time, returned in input order. Same fields as get_point_conditions for each point.

latDeg.description: Selenographic latitude in degrees, north positive, -90 to 90

lonDeg.description: Selenographic longitude in degrees, east positive, -180 to 360

points.description: 1 to 10 points to compare side by side

time.description: UTC time in ISO 8601 with a trailing Z, e.g. 2026-11-14T12:00:00Z. Defaults to now. Valid 2000-2100.

tools.name: list_presets
tools.description: List preset lunar surface locations (id, name, latitude/longitude and where the coordinates came from).
